name: Joshua Tree National Park
tagline: Joshua Tree — desert gardens and rock piles; short loops near the visitor center.

practical.ticket_note: Entrance pass; timed entry possible peak seasons.

practical.energy_note: Extreme heat in summer — water, shade, early start.

practical.season_note: Spring/fall best; summer is dangerous heat.
